name: send
description: Send text to a correspondent, focus, or channel. For a correspondent, `reference` confirms submission for delivery. A message to a focus becomes an observation and can wake it. On a channel, `accepted` confirms a handoff to a waiting receiver.

correspondent_id.description: Complete registered correspondent ID. A `correspondents` list gives the outgoing IDs known at the time it was recorded.

focus_id.description: Complete ID of an existing focus, including your own.

channel_id.description: Complete ID of an open channel.

name: open_channel
description: Open a channel for local programs. A host command can receive with `"$IVENNA" channel receive CHANNEL_ID` using the returned `channel_id`. An open channel keeps its ID after this focus ends or Ivenna restarts.

description.description: Briefly describe the channel's purpose and what each message should contain.

name: close_channel
description: Close a channel and disconnect its receivers.

name: open_focus
description: Open an activity to pursue this task while the core continues. It can run host commands and inherits all tool results from this round. The returned `focus_id` can receive messages after the round.

name: subscribe
description: Register this focus to receive reports that can wake it. Give the returned `subscription_id` to a listener you arrange. A host program can connect with `"$IVENNA" subscription listen SUBSCRIPTION_ID`.

listener.description: Saved description of what to report and when.

name: withdraw_subscription
description: Stop accepting reports for a subscription. Reports already accepted can still reach the subscribing focus, and the listener may keep running.
